meta.promptText: India mein 2000 rupees ke andar men ke liye konse brand ki jeans kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **₹2,000 ke andar men’s jeans** ke liye main quality + fit + value ke hisaab se ye brands prefer karunga:

1. **Pepe Jeans — Best overall** ⭐  
   Sale mein ₹1,449–₹1,999 ke aas-paas achhi straight/slim jeans mil rahi hain. [www.pepejeans.in](https://www.pepejeans.in/men/jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Meri first choice:** dark blue **straight fit**.

2. **Spykar — Best value**  
   Current sale mein ₹1,349–₹1,923 tak ke models mil rahe hain, including regular, slim aur skinny fits. [spykar.com](https://spykar.com/collections/men-jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   **Best:** daily wear ke liye regular/slim fit.

### [SPYKAR Men Mid-Wash Slim Fit Jeans]()
*₹1,710*

3. **Jack & Jones — Best stylish option**  
   Sale mein ₹1,499–₹1,799 ke models mil sakte hain; especially slim/washed styles. [www.jackjones.in](https://www.jackjones.in/products/150466901-light-grey-denim?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Jack & Jones Clark Regular Fit Jeans]()
*₹1,679*

4. **Levi's — Sale mein mile to definitely lo**  
   ₹2,000 ke andar Levi's milna possible hai, lekin usually sale/deal hunt karni padegi. 511 Slim jaise classic fits is budget mein achhe options hain. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/fashion/top-levis-jeans-for-men-under-2000-9201855?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Wrangler — Strong alternative**  
   Agar sale mein ₹1,500–₹2,000 ke andar genuine Wrangler mil jaye, to consider karna worth it hai.

### 🏆 Meri ranking ₹2,000 budget mein
**Pepe Jeans > Levi's (sale) > Spykar > Wrangler > Jack & Jones**

**Ek important tip:** Brand se zyada **fit** matter karta hai. Agar ek hi jeans leni hai, to **dark blue, mid-rise, straight/regular fit, minimal fading** lo — sabse versatile rahegi.

Agar tum **apni height, weight aur waist size (jaise 32/34)** bata do, main tumhare body type ke hisaab se **₹2,000 ke andar 5 exact jeans** choose karke de sakta hoon.
